blocks.zh: Section 5: Appendices — ECs in CTD & Change Management Principles｜附錄：CTD 中的 EC 與變更管理原則
blocks.en: Section 5: Appendices — ECs in CTD & Change Management Principles

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標 Learning Objectives
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 能夠在 CTD 結構中快速定位 DS（原料藥）和 DP（製劑）的 EC 位置，並區分哪些 CTD 模組通常含 EC、哪些通常為支撐性資訊
blocks.en: Be able to quickly locate the EC locations for the DS (drug substance) and DP (drug product) within the CTD structure, and distinguish which CTD modules usually contain ECs and which usually hold supportive information

blocks.zh: 掌握 CTD Module 3.2.S 和 3.2.P 中 最常見的 EC 類別（製造廠地、製程描述、規格/分析方法、容器密封、穩定性條件）
blocks.en: Master the most common EC categories in CTD Module 3.2.S and 3.2.P (manufacturing site, process description, specifications/analytical procedures, container closure, stability conditions)

blocks.zh: 能夠列舉並解釋 Appendix 2 的 十二項變更管理原則，理解完整變更管理生命週期
blocks.en: Be able to list and explain the twelve change management principles of Appendix 2, and understand the complete change management lifecycle

blocks.zh: 了解 知識管理（Knowledge Management） 在變更管理中的角色，以及 PQR 作為知識整合機制的功能
blocks.en: Understand the role of Knowledge Management in change management, and the function of the PQR as a knowledge integration mechanism

blocks.zh: 理解 管理層審查（Management Review） 對變更管理系統有效性監控的三個重點
blocks.en: Understand the three focus areas of Management Review in monitoring the effectiveness of the change management system

blocks.zh: Appendix 1: CTD Sections That Contain ECs｜含 EC 的 CTD 模組
blocks.en: Appendix 1: CTD Sections That Contain ECs

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜批次公式（Batch Formula）是 DP 的 EC
blocks.en: Key Point | Batch Formula is an EC for the DP

blocks.zh: CTD 3.2.P.3.2（批次公式）是製劑（DP）的 EC——這意味著批次公式的定性和定量成分變更（如賦形劑用量的調整）需要向監管機構報告。這對 CDMO 有直接影響：若接受客戶的製劑配方轉移，且計畫進行任何批次公式調整（如批量放大），必須先確認這是否構成 EC 變更，並按照適當的報告分類處理。
blocks.en: CTD 3.2.P.3.2 (Batch Formula) is an EC for the drug product (DP). This means that changes to the qualitative and quantitative composition of the batch formula (e.g., adjusting the amount of an excipient) must be reported to the regulatory authority. This has a direct impact on a CDMO: if it accepts a technology transfer of a client's DP formulation and plans any batch formula adjustment (such as batch size scale-up), it must first confirm whether this constitutes an EC change and handle it under the appropriate reporting category.

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜製程確效數據是支撐性資訊
blocks.en: Key Point | Process validation data are supportive information

blocks.zh: 儘管製程確效（Process Validation）對 GMP 合規至關重要，但其數據（S.2.5, P.3.5）在 CTD 中被定義為「支撐性資訊」而非 EC。這意味著：更新製程確效研究（如新的 PPQ 批次）本身不需要 EC 變更報告——只要相關的製程參數（EC）和規格（EC）沒有改變。然而，若驗證數據顯示某個製程參數的範圍需要調整（影響 EC），則需要啟動報告程序。
blocks.en: Although process validation is critical for GMP compliance, its data (S.2.5, P.3.5) are defined in the CTD as "supportive information" rather than ECs. This means that updating process validation studies (e.g., new PPQ batches) does not in itself require an EC change report, as long as the related process parameters (ECs) and specifications (ECs) have not changed. However, if the validation data show that the range of a process parameter needs to be adjusted (affecting an EC), the reporting procedure must be initiated.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜CTD 中的 EC vs. 支撐性資訊，就像「建物登記謄本」vs.「施工紀錄」
blocks.en: Analogy | ECs vs. supportive information in the CTD is like a "property registration transcript" vs. "construction records"

blocks.zh: CTD 中的 EC（如製造廠地、批次公式、規格）就像建物登記謄本上的核心資訊——這些是法定登記事項，任何改變都需要向地政局（監管機構）申報。支撐性資訊（如開發研究、確效數據）就像施工紀錄——它們是建造時的參考文件，解釋了「為什麼這樣蓋」，但不是法定登記的核心資訊，更新時無需向地政局申報。
blocks.en: The ECs in the CTD (such as manufacturing site, batch formula and specifications) are like the core information on a property registration transcript: these are legally registered items, and any change must be declared to the land registry (the regulatory authority). Supportive information (such as development studies and validation data) is like construction records: reference documents from the time of building that explain "why it was built this way", but they are not core legally registered information and need not be declared to the land registry when updated.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 要更換一種賦形劑的供應商（但規格和來源類型不變），根據 Appendix 1 的 CTD 位置，這是否涉及 EC 變更？需要考慮哪些 CTD 模組？
blocks.en: If a CDMO changes the supplier of an excipient (with the specification and source type unchanged), does this involve an EC change according to the CTD locations in Appendix 1? Which CTD modules need to be considered?

blocks.zh: 對於一個使用預填充注射器（drug-device combination）的生物製品，Appendix 1 指出「內容或位置可能依產品設計和地區而異」——這在實際 MAA 準備時意味著什麼樣的挑戰？
blocks.en: For a biological product using a prefilled syringe (drug-device combination), Appendix 1 states that "the content or location may vary depending on product design and region". What challenges does this pose in actual MAA preparation?

blocks.zh: 核心概念：EC 在 CTD 中的規律性分佈
blocks.en: Core Concept: The Pattern of EC Distribution in the CTD

blocks.zh: 從 Appendix 1 可以歸納出 EC 的分佈規律：
blocks.en: A pattern in the distribution of ECs can be drawn from Appendix 1:

blocks.zh: 支撐性資訊（非 EC）的規律：製程確效（S.2.5, P.3.5）、批次分析（S.4.4, P.5.4）、開發研究（S.2.6, P.2.x）、穩定性數據（S.7.3, P.8.3）——這些都是「論證 ECs 的科學依據」，本身不是 EC。
blocks.en: Pattern for supportive information (non-ECs): process validation (S.2.5, P.3.5), batch analyses (S.4.4, P.5.4), development studies (S.2.6, P.2.x) and stability data (S.7.3, P.8.3). These are all "the scientific basis for justifying the ECs" and are not ECs themselves.

blocks.zh: Appendix 2: Principles of Change Management｜變更管理原則
blocks.en: Appendix 2: Principles of Change Management

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜原則 2——EC 影響評估是核心步驟
blocks.en: Key Point | Principle 2: EC impact assessment is the core step

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 原則 2 特別強調：理解變更的範圍時，必須評估對 ECs 的影響以及對非 ECs 的影響。這個看似普通的要求，實際上有深刻含義：
blocks.en: Principle 2 of Appendix 2 specifically emphasizes that when understanding the scope of a change, the impact on ECs and the impact on non-ECs must both be assessed. This seemingly ordinary requirement has profound implications:

blocks.zh: 若變更影響了 EC → 啟動監管報告流程
blocks.en: If the change affects an EC → initiate the regulatory reporting process

blocks.zh: 若變更影響了非 EC 的 MAA 申報事項 → 仍需評估是否需要按地區規定更新申請
blocks.en: If the change affects MAA filing items that are not ECs → still assess whether the application must be updated under regional requirements

blocks.zh: 若變更僅影響 PQS 記錄事項 → 僅需 PQS 內部管控
blocks.en: If the change affects only items recorded in the PQS → only internal PQS control is needed

blocks.zh: 對 CDMO 而言，這意味著每次 CMC 變更的第一步，必須有一個系統化的「EC 影響評估」機制，這應該是變更控制 SOP 中的標準步驟。
blocks.en: For a CDMO, this means the first step of every CMC change must be a systematic "EC impact assessment" mechanism, which should be a standard step in the change control SOP.

blocks.zh: 重點提示｜原則 4——「不實施變更」的風險也要評估
blocks.en: Key Point | Principle 4: The risk of "not implementing the change" must also be assessed

blocks.zh: 原則 4 的一個容易被忽略的細節：除了評估「若實施變更的風險」，還要考慮「若不實施變更的潛在影響」。這反映了 Q12 對持續改善（continual improvement）的重視：若某個已知的製程缺陷（EC）不被修正，其對產品品質的持續風險可能超過實施變更的監管負擔。這個邏輯支持企業主動進行科學合理的製程改善，而不是以「避免監管麻煩」為由拒絕必要的 CMC 優化。
blocks.en: An easily overlooked detail of Principle 4: in addition to assessing "the risk if the change is implemented", one must also consider "the potential impact if the change is not implemented". This reflects the emphasis Q12 places on continual improvement: if a known process deficiency (an EC) is not corrected, its ongoing risk to product quality may outweigh the regulatory burden of implementing the change. This logic supports companies in proactively making scientifically sound process improvements, rather than refusing necessary CMC optimization on the grounds of "avoiding regulatory trouble".

blocks.zh: 管理層審查的三個監控指標
blocks.en: Three Monitoring Indicators for Management Review

blocks.zh:
1. 變更時效性（Timeliness）
   KPI 範例：
   · 緊急/關鍵變更的平均實施週期（天）
   · 延遲實施的變更比例及延遲原因分析
   · 延遲實施中有風險評估記錄的比例

2. 系統性能（Performance）
   KPI 範例：
   · 品質單位拒絕的變更申請比例
   · 返工/修改的變更申請比例（品質不夠首次通過）
   · 變更中發現未預期 EC 影響的比例

3. 實施後驗證有效性（Post-implementation）
   KPI 範例：
   · 有完成驗證記錄的變更比例
   · 驗證中發現非預期品質影響的比例
   · PLCM Document 在變更後 X 天內更新的比例
blocks.en:
1. Timeliness
   Example KPIs:
   · Average implementation cycle time (days) for urgent/critical changes
   · Proportion of changes implemented late, and analysis of reasons for delay
   · Proportion of delayed implementations with a risk assessment record

2. Performance
   Example KPIs:
   · Proportion of change requests rejected by the quality unit
   · Proportion of change requests reworked/revised (not right first time)
   · Proportion of changes in which an unexpected EC impact was found

3. Post-implementation verification of effectiveness
   Example KPIs:
   · Proportion of changes with a completed verification record
   · Proportion of verifications that found unexpected quality impacts
   · Proportion of PLCM Documents updated within X days after the change

blocks.zh: 比喻說明｜PQR 作為「知識整合雷達站」
blocks.en: Analogy | The PQR as a "knowledge integration radar station"

blocks.zh: PQR（Product Quality Review）在 Appendix 2 中被定位為「提供產品品質整體視角的機制」——就像一個「品質雷達站」：個別批次的偏差可能不明顯，但 PQR 把所有數據匯總後，趨勢就變得清晰了（如偏差頻率、製程能力下降），這些趨勢正是識別「需要變更」的誘因的最佳來源。這也是為什麼 Appendix 2 原則 11c 要求每個變更都要納入 PQR 評估——通過 PQR，公司可以系統性地監控所有已實施變更的效果，形成知識管理的閉環。
blocks.en: In Appendix 2 the PQR (Product Quality Review) is positioned as "a mechanism that provides an overall view of product quality", like a "quality radar station": deviations in individual batches may not stand out, but once the PQR consolidates all the data, trends become clear (such as deviation frequency or declining process capability), and these trends are the best source for identifying the triggers that indicate a "need for change". This is also why Principle 11c of Appendix 2 requires every change to be included in the PQR evaluation: through the PQR, a company can systematically monitor the effect of all implemented changes, closing the loop of knowledge management.

blocks.zh: 實務應用｜CDMO 的「Q12 合規變更控制 SOP」設計
blocks.en: Practical Application | Designing a "Q12-compliant change control SOP" for a CDMO

blocks.zh: 依據 Appendix 2，CDMO 的變更控制 SOP 應整合以下 Q12 特定要素：
blocks.en: Based on Appendix 2, a CDMO's change control SOP should incorporate the following Q12-specific elements:

blocks.zh: EC 影響評估表格：每次變更初始評估時，必填項目包含「此變更是否影響任何已識別的 EC？」
blocks.en: EC impact assessment form: a mandatory item at the initial assessment of every change, including the question "Does this change affect any identified EC?"

blocks.zh: PLCM Document 更新檢查點：在變更實施後的 X 天內，法規事務部門完成 PLCM Document 的必要更新
blocks.en: PLCM Document update checkpoint: within X days after the change is implemented, the regulatory affairs department completes the necessary update of the PLCM Document

blocks.zh: PACMP 一致性確認：若變更是在已核准的 PACMP 下執行，在實施前必須確認當前狀況與 PACMP Step 1 的假設一致
blocks.en: PACMP consistency confirmation: if the change is executed under an approved PACMP, confirm before implementation that the current situation is consistent with the assumptions in PACMP Step 1

blocks.zh: 知識捕捉環節：變更完成後，製程知識更新應記錄在指定的知識管理系統中（可供下次相關變更參考）
blocks.en: Knowledge capture step: after the change is completed, the updated process knowledge should be recorded in the designated knowledge management system (available for reference in the next related change)

blocks.zh: PQR 連結：每個已完成的 CMC 變更均標記為下一個 PQR 週期的評估項目
blocks.en: PQR link: every completed CMC change is flagged as an item for evaluation in the next PQR cycle

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 原則 8a 要求「實施前確認與 PLCM Document 或 PACMP 一致」——如果公司的 PLCM Document 已過期（未及時更新），會對 CMC 變更的實施產生什麼法規風險？
blocks.en: Principle 8a of Appendix 2 requires "confirmation before implementation that the change is consistent with the PLCM Document or PACMP". If a company's PLCM Document is out of date (not updated in time), what regulatory risks does this create for implementing CMC changes?

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 提到「不應有正式的知識管理系統的額外監管要求」（Q&A 明確指出）——這是否意味著知識管理是可選的？結合 Q12 框架解釋其實際地位。
blocks.en: Appendix 2 mentions that "there should be no additional regulatory requirement for a formal knowledge management system" (as the Q&A makes clear). Does this mean knowledge management is optional? Explain its actual status in the context of the Q12 framework.

blocks.zh: 若 CDMO 的 PQR 顯示某個製程的穩定性趨勢在近三年持續下降（但尚未超出 EC 範圍），Appendix 2 的哪幾項原則應該被觸發？具體的後續行動是什麼？
blocks.en: If a CDMO's PQR shows that the stability trend of a process has been declining continuously over the past three years (but has not yet exceeded the EC range), which principles of Appendix 2 should be triggered? What are the specific follow-up actions?

blocks.zh: 十二項變更管理原則的生命週期視角
blocks.en: The Twelve Change Management Principles from a Lifecycle Perspective

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 的 12 項原則構成了一個完整的變更管理生命週期：
blocks.en: The 12 principles of Appendix 2 form a complete change management lifecycle:

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: Appendix 1 EC 分佈規律：EC 主要集中在廠地（S.2.1/P.3.1）、製程（S.2.2/P.3.3）、物料管控（S.2.3-2.4/P.3.4）、規格/分析方法（S.4.1-4.2/P.5.1-5.2）、容器密封（S.6/P.7）、穩定性（S.7.1/P.8.1）
blocks.en: Pattern of EC distribution in Appendix 1: ECs are concentrated mainly in site (S.2.1/P.3.1), process (S.2.2/P.3.3), material controls (S.2.3-2.4/P.3.4), specifications/analytical procedures (S.4.1-4.2/P.5.1-5.2), container closure (S.6/P.7) and stability (S.7.1/P.8.1)

blocks.zh: 支撐性資訊模式：製程確效、批次分析、開發研究、穩定性數據——均為支撐性資訊，非 EC；理解這個模式可快速定位 EC 影響評估的重點
blocks.en: Pattern of supportive information: process validation, batch analyses, development studies and stability data are all supportive information, not ECs; understanding this pattern lets you quickly locate the focus of an EC impact assessment

blocks.zh: Appendix 2 的 12 項原則 涵蓋完整變更生命週期：識別誘因 → 範圍評估（含 EC 影響）→ 知識利用 → 風險評估 → 研究設計 → 監管報告 → 跨部門核准 → 實施確認 → 偏差管理 → 實施後驗證 → 知識更新/PLCM 更新/PQR → 查廠準備
blocks.en: The 12 principles of Appendix 2 cover the complete change lifecycle: identify the trigger → assess scope (including EC impact) → use knowledge → risk assessment → study design → regulatory reporting → cross-functional approval → implementation confirmation → deviation management → post-implementation verification → knowledge update/PLCM update/PQR → inspection readiness

blocks.zh: 關鍵原則：不實施變更的風險也必須評估（原則 4）；EC 影響評估是每次變更的必要步驟（原則 2）
blocks.en: Key principles: the risk of not implementing a change must also be assessed (Principle 4); EC impact assessment is a necessary step for every change (Principle 2)

blocks.zh: PQR 的角色：整合多源知識的品質雷達站，識別個別批次看不出的趨勢，是變更誘因的主要來源之一
blocks.en: Role of the PQR: a quality radar station that integrates knowledge from multiple sources and identifies trends invisible in individual batches; it is one of the main sources of change triggers

blocks.zh: 管理層審查三指標：時效性（Timeliness）、系統性能（Performance）、實施後驗證（Post-implementation verification）——定期監控，持續改善變更管理系統本身
blocks.en: Three Management Review indicators: Timeliness, Performance and Post-implementation verification; monitor them regularly to continually improve the change management system itself
